properties.surficial_geology: Vashon advance outwash and lodgement till (glaciomarine drift gravels, sand, compact clay)
properties.soil_profile: Alderwood gravelly sandy loam, moderate drainage with coastal moisture retention
properties.topography: Gentle coastal marine terrace sloping eastward towards Appletree Cove and Puget Sound

structures.name: North Commercial Waterfront Building
structures.primary_material: Horizontal painted cedar lap siding, corrugated metal and composition shingle gabled roofing
structures.fenestration: Double-hung commercial insulated glazing with white painted wood casings

structures.name: West Main Street Retail Row
structures.primary_material: Timber frame with clapboard siding and parapet flat roof with bitumen membrane
structures.fenestration: Aluminum-framed storefront display windows and recessed glass entryways

civil_infrastructure.roadway: NE State Highway 104 terminal approach, high-durability bituminous asphalt paving
civil_infrastructure.markings: Thermoplastic white crosswalk ladder stripes, green-painted bicycle transitions, designated parking stalls
civil_infrastructure.curbs_sidewalks: Brushed aggregate poured concrete pedestrian walkways and ADA-compliant curb cuts
civil_infrastructure.street_furniture: Galvanized steel luminaire poles, coastal signage, marine parking pay stations

properties.canopy: Mature Western Red Cedar (Thuja plicata), Douglas fir (Pseudotsuga menziesii), Bigleaf Maple (Acer macrophyllum)
properties.understory: Salal (Gaultheria shallon), Sword fern (Polystichum munitum), cultivated municipal coastal turfgrass
properties.marine_influence: High-salinity maritime air, frequent morning mist, cool temperate coastal Puget Sound microclimate
